Lower Text: [All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted, by deleting 1 other Digimon with [Sukamon] in its name, prevent that deletion.
Upper Text: [On Deletion] By trashing 1 card with [Etemon] or [Sukamon] in its name in your hand, return this card to the hand.
(Rule) Name: Also treated as having [Etemon] and [Sukamon].
